generic_domain.justification: AI Ops (Artificial Intelligence for IT Operations) is the most generic domain as it involves applying AI techniques to optimize and automate IT operations. This includes monitoring, incident management, automation, and analytics. Since MLOps focuses specifically on machine learning lifecycle and optimization, which falls under a broader umbrella of operationalizing AI systems, AI Ops encompasses MLOps by nature. Therefore, selecting AI Ops allows for the inclusion and application across all related operational aspects including but not limited to Machine Learning Operations.
